http/proxy_connection#

Connections through a proxy for one client pool.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

Connections through a proxy for one client pool. Proxied uses it.

Public API#

object HttpProxyRouting#

object HttpProxyRouting does HttpConversationRouting

A routing capability is fixed for one client pool. Only the actual proxy socket is locally resolved/filtered; remote origin routing belongs to proxy.

HttpProxyRouting.HttpProxyRouting#

HttpProxyRouting(proxy is ProxyPolicy, resolver is Resolving, tls is TlsClientPolicy, client is ClientPolicy, clock is Timing)

Routes through proxy; only the proxy's address is resolved and checked.

HttpProxyRouting.connecting#

connecting(url is UrlParts) is HttpConversationConnecting

How to reach url through the proxy.

HttpProxyRouting.allowed#

allowed(url is UrlParts, details is ExchangeDetails, access is EndpointAllowing) is bool

Whether a connection with details may serve url.
